title: Service change
summary: A service change as one loop on one screen: the network on a map, a worklist of what is weak (frequency holes, long waits, missed connections at hubs), a route or hub opened over the map to change, the findings you watch re-read after every change, and the proposal across every day type.
questions: Which plan am I changing, against which baseline, and which day types does it run in its period?
Where does the network run, and which routes has this plan changed?
What is weak: frequency holes, long waits, connections that just miss at a hub?
Opening one finding: what route or hub is it, and what does its day look like?
Change it: span, running time, one trip, stops — over the picture.
Did it work: the findings I watch, before and after each change; what the plan resolved.
What does the proposal change across every day type, and is it ready to publish?
session: 2026-11-11 on C-TRAN (testdata/ctran-gtfs.zip): caps-run day_types, network_findings (1-WKDY + 1-WKDY/31: 2 holes, 15+ waits, 15+ misses at the transit centers), plan_compare, route_lines (29 routes) — the browser, forked to Winter 2027, reads the same worklist; D-136, D-137 provisional
